name: EZ Bar Spider Curl
steps: Lie chest-down on a moderately inclined bench with your feet braced behind you and hold the EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight down vertically from your shoulders beneath the front edge of the bench.
Curl the EZ bar smoothly upward toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms perpendicular to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top to squeeze your biceps, then lower the bar slowly back to full extension.
tips: Keep your chest pressed against the bench so you cannot swing your torso for momentum.
Keep your elbows pointed straight down rather than pulling them back toward your ribs.
